sourceText:
Oatmeal "Xocai Healthy Chocolate" Bars
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Saturday, December 10, 2011 - 10:34am

Ingredients




1 12 cups quick oats
1 cup wheat flour
34 cup brown sugar (or sugar substitute)
12 cup coconut oil (or butter)
1 cup sweetened condensed milk
6 chunks dark chocolate (Xocai Nuggets, shaved)

Preparation

1 Mix first 4 indigents together, reserve 1/4 of the dough. Press the remaining dough into a greased 9x9 inch pan. Save the rest for topping. Bake for 10 minutes in a 350 degree oven. Top with sweetened condensed milk. Add the "Xocai Nuggets" to the reserved crust mixture and press down in the pan. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes. Serves 6

Comments:
fenny frasiska

Yummy . . . Yummy . . .
And so healthy . . . :)
